title: Storerooms in the House of the Lord

request.style: English, male solo voice with warm choir backing, harp, flute, strings, timpani, solemn and reverent mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
King Hezekiah gave the order
Prepare the storerooms in the house
The Lord received their faithful work
They brought the contributions in the dust

[Verse]
Mahath son of Amasai stepped forward
With Joel son of Azariah there
From the Kohathites they came in light
To serve the Lord without a fear

[Chorus]
Storerooms in the house of the Lord
Faithfully they brought the tithes
Dedicated gifts and holy things
Served under Conaniah and Shimei

[Verse]
Jehiel and Azaziah served
Nahath and Asahel stood strong
Jerimoth and Jozabad kept watch
Eliel and Ismachiah belonged

[Chorus]
Storerooms in the house of the Lord
Faithfully they brought the tithes
Dedicated gifts and holy things
Served under Conaniah and Shimei

[Bridge]
By appointment of King Hezekiah
And Azariah the official named
In charge of the house of God
The faithful service was not blamed

[Chorus]
Storerooms in the house of the Lord
Faithfully they brought the tithes
Dedicated gifts and holy things
Served under Conaniah and Shimei

[Outro]
Distributing to priests and Levites
According to their duties there
The work of the house was done
With faithfulness beyond compare
